title: GTIN present
question: Do sampled products carry a GTIN?
method: Read gtin, gtin8, gtin12, gtin13 or gtin14 from Product JSON-LD, or global_unique_id from the Store API. Pass when at least 80 percent of sampled products have one; warn above 50 percent; fail below.

title: GTIN valid
question: Are the GTINs real GTINs?
method: Each GTIN must be 8, 12, 13 or 14 digits and pass the GS1 check digit. Pass when all found GTINs are valid; fail when any is not.

title: Brand present as entity
question: Is the brand a Brand object with a consistent name?
method: Pass when Product.brand is a Brand (or Organization) object with a name on all sampled products; warn when it is a bare string or its casing varies across the sample; fail when absent.

title: MPN present when GTIN absent
question: Do products without a GTIN have a brand plus MPN fallback?
method: For sampled products without a GTIN, pass when mpn and brand are both present. Skip when every sampled product has a GTIN.

title: SKU present and unique in sample
question: Does every sampled product have a SKU, and are they distinct?
method: Read sku from JSON-LD or the Store API. Pass when all sampled products have one and no two share it; warn on a duplicate; fail when missing.
